name: Ironband's Compound
summary: At Ironband's Compound, Tormus Deepforge seeks vengeance for his slain mentor, Sturgy Ironband. Rare umbral ore drew the Dark Iron dwarves to the outpost and brought it down.

sections.title: A Master's Fall
sections.body: South of Helm's Bed Lake, Sturgy Ironband taught smithing at a compound away from the Great Forge's crowded anvils. Promising pupils came there to train under a master revered across Ironforge as an unmatched instructor. Then one student acquired an unfamiliar mineral called umbral ore, and Sturgy chose to experiment with it. He did not know that its presence had marked his school for ruin.

sections.title: The Dark Iron Raid
sections.body: Soon after the umbral ore arrived, Dark Iron dwarves attacked the compound. They killed Sturgy Ironband and every apprentice in his care, then took over the grounds. Tormus Deepforge, one of Ironband's surviving protégés in the capital, refuses to let the massacre go unanswered. He sends Alliance travelers to avenge his teacher and recover the ore that brought destruction to the outpost.

faq.answer: Ironband's Compound lies in eastern Dun Morogh, south of Helm's Bed Lake.
Sturgy Ironband was a renowned dwarven master blacksmith who taught advanced metalworking at a compound outside Ironforge. Dark Iron dwarves killed him in a raid.

faq.q: Why did the Dark Iron dwarves attack the compound?
faq.answer: One of Ironband's students brought umbral ore to the compound, drawing the Dark Iron dwarves there. They attacked soon after it arrived, killed everyone present, and took control of the site.
Umbral ore is an uncommon, mysterious mineral that caught Master Ironband's interest. Its arrival drew the lethal attention of the Dark Iron clan.
Tormus Deepforge is an Ironforge blacksmith and former apprentice of Sturgy Ironband. Grieving his teacher's death, he sends travelers to punish the Dark Iron intruders and retrieve the ore.

faq.q: What does Tormus want recovered from the compound?
faq.answer: Tormus wants travelers to avenge Ironband by driving out the Dark Iron raiders and recovering the shipment of umbral ore that brought the disaster.

angles.text: Sturgy Ironband's fate shows the danger untested ores can bring to a forge.
The attack on Ironband's outpost reflects the bitter hatred between Ironforge's Bronzebeard dwarves and their Dark Iron kin.
